verdict.rationale: Vendor docs describe robust support for building custom AI agents — natural-language agent creation ('Describe any workflow... to create a unique agent'), configurable rules/goals, scoping/permissions, multi-channel deployment (Slack, WhatsApp, API, MCP), and a code-first apps framework with Models API access to Anthropic/OpenAI/Google. No community evidence directly contradicts the agent-building capability, though general product-quality complaints exist for other features.
